hooks.command:
python3 -c "import sys,json,subprocess,os
try:
    inp=json.loads(sys.stdin.read())
    fp=inp.get('file_path') or inp.get('path') or ''
    if fp:
        proj=os.environ.get('CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR','.')
        rel=os.path.relpath(fp,proj)
        subprocess.run(['steward','pre-edit-check',rel],cwd=proj,timeout=2,capture_output=True)
except Exception:
    pass
"
